content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-256. - Administration of the lodging tax.
content.summary:
The finance director shall administer the provisions of this article. The city manager
               may promulgate rules or regulations to aid in the enforcement and administration of
               this article pursuant to the provisions of
section 2-141
et seq.
(Code 1981, § 31-116; Ord. No. 378…
